map.为什么实际摄入会高于包装标称值？: Why is actual intake higher than the labelled value?
map.标称值来自机测口径——检测仪器按标准程序抽吸，且滤嘴通风孔保持开放。真人吸食时常: The label uses machine scope — instruments puff per a standard protocol with vent holes open. Real smokers often unconsciously cover the vents with finger or lip, reducing air intake and making each puff denser; measured intake is generally higher, reports say by one to over two times, so this tool uses K to express that scope difference.
map.焦油和尼古丁能互相换算吗？: Can tar and nicotine be converted into each other?

The nicotine@10:1, @12:1 lines in the table are common industry ratios for magnitude comparison, not conversion.
